description: This file defines simple methods related to routing task associations in a manufacturing workflow, including adding and updating routing task associations, with logic for validation, copying, and service calls.

methods.name: addRoutingTaskAssoc
methods.description: Creates a new routing task association, possibly copying a routing task when specified, and performing validation checks.

methods.name: updateRoutingTaskAssoc
methods.description: Updates an existing routing task association after validation of sequence number and date.
